# tests/fixtures

Synthetic test fixtures for Treska, generated by the scripts in this folder.

## Files

| File | Generator | Contents |
|------|-----------|----------|
| `android_sample.zip` | `make_android_fixture.py` | Synthetic Android logical extraction: contacts, call log, SMS/MMS, WhatsApp, Chrome history |
| `ios_sample.zip` | `make_ios_fixture.py` | Synthetic iOS logical extraction: SMS/iMessage, WhatsApp, address book, call history, Safari history, KnowledgeC |
| `flag_scan_sample.zip` | `make_flag_fixture.py` | Synthetic flag-scan fixture: decoy flag-like strings and one base64-wrapped flag |
| `sample.zip` | `make_fixtures.py` | Small multi-file zip: file-type mismatch, empty file, image and SQLite cases |
| `sample.db` | `make_fixtures.py` | Minimal SQLite fixture |
| `mismatch.txt` | `make_fixtures.py` | PNG bytes saved with a `.txt` name (type-mismatch case) |
| `empty.bin` | `make_fixtures.py` | Zero-byte file |
| `readme.txt` | `make_fixtures.py` | One-line label |

## Regenerating

```
python tests/fixtures/make_fixtures.py
python tests/fixtures/make_android_fixture.py
python tests/fixtures/make_ios_fixture.py
python tests/fixtures/make_flag_fixture.py
```

Test data. All fixtures are synthetic. Phone numbers use the reserved range 555-0100 to 555-0199; email addresses use example.org; URLs use example domains. Listed exceptions: WhatsApp-style identifiers such as 15550100@s.whatsapp.net; placeholder group identifiers 120363000000000001@g.us and 120363000000000002@g.us; and one google.com search URL in the Android fixture's browser history.
